title: Source diagnostics
summaryHelp: Counts cover all your accessible locations, regardless of filters. Readings include enabled sources and sensors, hardware still in service and valid HTTP/MQTT settings.
freshnessHelp: A reading is recent for at least 120 seconds, or twice the sensor’s expected interval if longer. Without an interval, freshness is unknown. This does not confirm that the device or provider is online.
empty: No matching sources. Manually added sensors without a data link are not listed.
activityHelp: The last reception and last reading may refer to different data. Delayed or repeated readings do not confirm current activity.
unknownError: A recorded error is not recognized. Open the source settings for further inspection.

validation.filtersInvalid: Check the filters and choose a valid page.
